title: The maximal ideals of a Noetherian local ring and of its completion need equally many generators
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring and $A^\wedge=\varprojlim_nA/\mathfrak m^n$ its $\mathfrak m$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_{A^\wedge}=\mathfrak mA^\wedge$. For an ideal $I$ write $\mu(I)$ for the minimal number of elements generating it. Then $\mu(\mathfrak m_{A^\wedge})=\mu(\mathfrak m)$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 05GG (lemma-hathat-finitely-generated: A/m^2 = A^/m^2A^, so m/m^2 = mA^/(mA^)^2 over the common residue field) with Nakayama's Lemma Tag 00DV (lemma-NAK: mu of the maximal ideal of a Noetherian local ring is dim_k m/m^2); used in More on Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07NY (lemma-completion-regular)
